allow_instructions: Pre-authorized: Skippy scheduled and manual contribution-queue sweeps (Maintain → Learn → Replenish) for SkillSpector, NemoClaw, Inspect AI, Apache Hadoop, Apache Airflow, and sibling OSS checkouts under ~/nvidia/oss.

Pre-authorized without confirmation: gh pr list/view/comment/create/checks, gh api read/write on contributor fork PRs, gh pr update-branch --rebase, opening replenishment PRs on forks, posting short maintain status comments.

Pre-authorized without confirmation: git fetch, git rebase, git commit -s on authored branches, git push and git push --force-with-lease to fork remotes (origin, fork) only — never upstream/apache/NVIDIA main.
Pre-authorized without confirmation: scripts/sweep-maintain.sh, sweep-log.sh, sweep-notify.sh, start/stop sweep loops, queue-policy.md and learning-log updates in skippy.

These are routine non-destructive OSS contribution maintenance actions. Do not pause scheduled ticks for Smart Mode approval. Only stop for true destructive ops: force-push to upstream/main, delete protected branches, git reset --hard on shared branches, or commits containing secrets.
Prefer gh pr update-branch --rebase over local worktree rebase when updating stale PR bases.
block_instructions: git push --force to apache/* or NVIDIA/* upstream default branches
git push --force-with-lease to upstream without explicit user request
